description: This PHP class 'FormatWithCompetency' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format a given value into a competency string based on the 'EmployeeLanguage' entity's competencies array. It is part of the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin' in the 'FormatValue' namespace, specifically used for formatting competency-related data within the human resource management system.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetency
classes.description: Implements ValueFormatter to convert an entity value into a competency string using a predefined array.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the competency string corresponding to the given entity value or null if not found.
